caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object consisting of several interconnected parts, mainly rendered in shades of brown. The main structure features two vertical side pieces supporting two horizontal rails at the top and middle, forming a rectangular frame. A diagonal wooden brace extends from the lower horizontal rail to the bottom center, with a sawtooth notched edge and a small circular hole. Attached at the lower part is a wide horizontal base plank with decorative cutouts along its bottom edge, and this base extends slightly outward on both ends. Two thin rods or pegs, colored yellow, are inserted diagonally into the front corners of the base, angling upward toward the viewer. The object casts a light shadow on a plain, off-white background. The artist’s small signature, "FRANK KASLE," is present in the bottom left corner.
title: Book Rest - Mahogany
